b_total_nT.note: formula: |B| = sqrt(Be^2 + Bn^2 + Bu^2) from the IGRF model at geodetic lat, lon, altitude and time; inputs: iss.lat, iss.lon, iss.alt_km, iss.as_of

ambient_nT.note: formula: |B| = sqrt(Be^2 + Bn^2 + Bu^2) from the IGRF model at geodetic lat, lon, altitude and time; inputs: iss.lat, iss.lon, iss.alt_km, iss.as_of

opm_range_nT.source: QuSpin QZFM Gen-3 product page, https://quspin.com/products-qzfm/
opm_range_nT.note: QZFM dynamic range ±5 nT (specs.opm.dynamic_range). QuSpin also states the field at the sensor must be reduced to about 50 nT or below; built-in coils cancel residual fields up to 50 nT.

shielding_factor.note: formula: ambient_nT / opm_range_nT; inputs: iss.ambient_field_nT, specs.opm.dynamic_range. Uses the external field. Fields inside a spacecraft cabin are larger; OSCAR-QUBE reported interference from station equipment.
